verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way to version, review, or roll back automations (agent definitions, configs, or runs) in the SDK. Session persistence, forking, and SessionStore mirroring cover conversation history, not automation versioning or rollback. Keeping filesystem-based agent config such as CLAUDE.md or skills in source control would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
